title: TEST CHAMBER 11
pa: Precision placement and maximum-reach testing are now combined.
The staff passage remains an undocumented convenience.

addedBoxes.note: North rail guides the long downhill roll to a plate offset toward the other rail.
South rail makes the chute narrow enough to prevent lateral escape.
End stop catches the crate beside the offset pressure plate.
Tall sight blocker hides the plate landing from the chamber's centre without touching the chute.
First tucked-away staff foothold; top at 0.75 m.
Second staff foothold; top at 1.55 m.
Third staff foothold; top at 2.35 m.
Fourth staff foothold; top at 3.15 m.
Fifth staff foothold; top at 3.95 m.
Narrow final catwalk reaches the open high east hatch entirely above y = 3.
Fix: staff bridge from the high walkway north to the shell catwalk at the real staff hatch (z -4.5); the walkway alone dead-ends at the wall above the door.

solution: Possess the arm and press the heavy button at (6.8, 2.1, 1.55), just 0.02 m inside the arm's maximum reach.
Fly the drone to the high north-west panel and zap it for override.
Set the heavy crate rolling from (4.2, 1.55, -4.85) down the long steel chute; guide rails and the end stop settle it over the offset plate at (10.55, -5.2), beyond carrying range.
Possess the base and use the normal low east door once the plate and override are active.

Hidden: after the button, override and plate, find the alternating black and steel footholds at the south-east edge, climb only 0.75 to 0.80 m at a time, then cross the raised catwalk to exit above y = 3.
